envelope.description: Controller answers by callId, frame tokens and the MCP schema

body.title: Controller answers by callId, frame tokens and the MCP schema
body.summary: The judgements phase accepts answers [{ callId, output }] for an emit_calls frame; applyAnswer advances each job; a fresh token per frame with the previous released; a wrong callId is bad-judgements and a replayed token state-not-found; the insrc_code_review_step MCP input schema accepts answers, forwarded unchanged; the last answers drive the runner.
acceptanceChecks: An over-budget review completes through the registered MCP tool frame by frame and writes the same record as the daemon path.
A wrong callId is bad-judgements and a replayed frame token is state-not-found.
